Komaromy's Kerecsenyi letters (pp. 130-132 and 249) print the signs only as the editor's placeholder: '(titkos jel)' occurs 2x in no. 25 (18 Sep 1555), 2x in no. 26 (23 Sep, e.g. 'az teb (titkos jel) kirol', 'jol erti (titkos jel)'), 2x in no. 27 (26 Sep, 'az egesz orszag (titkos jel) tebbet irnek, de (titkos jel)') and 1x in no. 36 (Celje, 7 May 1556, 'ha (titkos jel)'), seven single signs in all, no number groups and no decipherment printed. So the cipher survives only as a few sign-words in the originals (MNL OL E 185, Nadasdy archive), not seen or digitised here; Lang 2015 p. 248 C.Ker.01 'magyar jelek, megfejtetlen, reszleges'. Too little and not visible: no open verdict. Would unblock it: scans of the four MNL originals.
